aggregate_health.guard_scope: Recorded aggregate guards retain native penalties; full per-life search status is not retained.

acquisition.limitation: Native summaries, not complete per-life raw search ledgers.

limitations: One uninterrupted eight-generation acquisition trajectory; confirmation seeds are not evolutionary repetitions.
Raw status coverage is all7680 confirmation lives; native search statuses have only saved aggregate coverage.
The primary is generation8 minus the fixed AM start on blink80_20; generation4 cannot replace generation8 after confirmation.
Full native genetic/selection replay, including the generation4 checkpoint, is a separate independent audit.
Ten-percent retention margin is conventional; null effects do not establish retention.
A frozen genome may develop differently across worlds; no circuit or memory claim.
